business_summary: Square Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures low-temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) materials, radio-frequency components, and ceramic substrate. It offers 90-degrees hybrid, directional, asymmetric, and broadband couplers; Doherty combiners; terminations; delay lines; dividers; attenuators; quadrifilars; and MCP foundry service with LTCC, alumina, AlN, Al2O3, and ZTA substrates. The company was formerly known as RN2 Technologies Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Square Tech Co., Ltd. in November 2026. Square Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Hwaseong-si, South Korea.
